## Map

Add a pin for each place you've been by editing the `places` array below —
each entry just needs a name, lat/lng, and a short note.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
L = require("leaflet@1.9.4")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
places = [
  { name: "Example City, Country", lat: 0, lng: 0, note: "What you did there, when" }
  // add more entries here
]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const container = DOM.element("div", { style: "height:420px;border-radius:6px;" });
  yield container;
  const map = L.map(container).setView([20, 0], 2);
  L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
    attribution: "© OpenStreetMap contributors"
  }).addTo(map);
  places.forEach(p => {
    L.marker([p.lat, p.lng]).addTo(map).bindPopup(`<b>${p.name}</b><br>${p.note}`);
  });
}
```
